findings.issue: ssr2 is a per-instance prose pin: it greps one docstring (_seeded_repo.__doc__) for '<N> git calls' and also requires the literal phrase 'same git calls every time'. It does NOT duplicate the prose-number lint (checked: _output_lints._prose_number_claim returns None for 'the init, config, add and commit are the same five git calls every time', for '5 git calls' and for 'twelve git calls', because 'N <noun>' is a shape the lint deliberately refuses, see prose_number_claims 'WHAT IT CANNOT SEE'), so it is not redundant with it. But it guards one sentence of one helper, not the class the lint leaves to the author, and the second conjunct pins wording: any rewording of the docstring turns the suite red with no behaviour changed. The task asked only to delete the number.
findings.resolution: Keep the number-free check if a pin is wanted, but drop the 'same git calls every time' conjunct (and bool(doc) only if a missing docstring is deliberately tolerated); or drop ssr2 and rely on the author-enforced rule. Do not remove it on the grounds that the lint covers it: the lint does not.
